mentions.name: AI-run Amazon e-commerce operations
mentions.description: This project hands off as much of the operation of Amazon e-commerce brands as possible to AI, replacing manual business workflows with automated AI-driven processes. It doubles as an ongoing evaluation of new AI models and products as they come out.
mentions.problem: Operating e-commerce brands manually takes too much time; the goal is time savings by offloading operations to AI.
mentions.source_excerpt: I buy and operate e-commerce brands that sell on Amazon, and I'm working on handing as much of the operation of the business off to AI as possible.
